nodeSources.deliver:
# Deliver the routine's Markdown answer to the owner only, by email or as a Teams message to themselves. import html import json from urllib.parse import urlparse import bs4 import markdown from semoss import Insight FONT = "Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" TEAMS_LIMIT = 24000 # Links the agent writes can come from mail it read; keep only Microsoft 365 ones. LINK_HOSTS = ("outlook.office.com", "outlook.office365.com", "outlook.live.com", "teams.microsoft.com", "sharepoint.com", "onedrive.live.com", "office.com") STYLES = { "h1": "margin:18px 0 8px; font-size:20px; font-weight:bold;", "h2": "margin:18px 0 8px; font-size:17px; font-weight:bold;", "h3": "margin:14px 0 6px; font-size:15px; font-weight:bold;", "p": "margin:0 0 10px;", "ul": "margin:0 0 12px; padding:0 0 0 20px;", "ol": "margin:0 0 12px; padding:0 0 0 20px;", "li": "margin:0 0 6px;", "table": "border-collapse:collapse; margin:0 0 12px;", "th": "padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid #D0D0CE; text-align:left;", "td": "padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid #D0D0CE;", } def _allowed(href): try: url = urlparse(str(href or "")) except ValueError: return False host = (url.hostname or "").lower() return url.scheme == "https" and any(host == h or host.endswith("." + h) for h in LINK_HOSTS) def _pixel_value(name, value): # Pixel decodes \u escapes, so model text can never open an tag in the Pixel. return name + "=[" + json.dumps(value).replace("<", "\\u003c") + "]" def _run(pixel, what): ret = Insight().run_pixel(pixel, raw=True) last = ret[0]["pixelReturn"][-1] if "ERROR" in str(last.get("operationType")): raise RuntimeError(what + " failed: " + str(last.get("output"))) def run(scope): recipient = str(scope.get("owner_email") or "").strip() delivery = str(scope.get("delivery") or "email").strip().lower() name = str(scope.get("routine_name") or "Routine").strip() # Escape raw HTML first, so only Markdown formatting reaches the message. escaped = str(scope["answer"]).replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<") soup = bs4.BeautifulSoup(markdown.markdown(escaped, extensions=["tables"]), "html.parser") for image in soup.find_all("img"): image.decompose() for link in soup.find_all("a"): if not _allowed(link.get("href")): link.unwrap() for tag in soup.find_all(list(STYLES)): tag["style"] = STYLES[tag.name] content = str(soup) if delivery == "none": return {"sent": False, "to": None, "html": content} if not recipient: raise ValueError("There is no owner address to deliver to.") if delivery == "teams": message = "

" + html.escape(name) + "

" + content if len(message) > TEAMS_LIMIT: message = message[:TEAMS_LIMIT] + "

(Shortened. Open Routines for the full result.)

" _run("MicrosoftTeamsSendChatMessage(" + ", ".join([ _pixel_value("recipients", [recipient]), _pixel_value("message", message), _pixel_value("html", True), ]) + ");", "Sending the Teams message") else: body = ('
' + content + '

Sent to you by your routine "' + html.escape(name) + '". Change or pause it in Routines.

') _run("MicrosoftOutlookSendMail(" + ", ".join([ _pixel_value("to", [recipient]), _pixel_value("subject", name), _pixel_value("body", body), _pixel_value("html", True), ]) + ");", "Sending the email") return {"sent": True, "to": recipient, "html": content}
